terrain._todo: OQ-MAP-TERRAIN: off is a first guess, not measured; each casting terrain chunk costs a shadow draw per split on the phone, so a Fold measurement decides it.

proxy_limits._todo: OQ-MAP-PROXY: placeholder limits on tree counts (MapChunks.proxies), not measured frame cost; a Fold measurement decides them.
proxy_limits._note: Each limit is the larger of the two maps' measured values (alesia_section, test_300; measured after stop 6, the decor looks batched per chunk, chunk_size_m 50) times 1.5, rounded up to the next step of 1 below 10, 5 below 100, 50 below 1000.

classes._todo: OQ-MAP-CULL: every distance here is a first guess for Shibi (a 1 km map, a 200 m aim ray), not measured; a Fold measurement and play decide them.
classes._note: MapChunks puts each batch in a class: by_type "<source>/<type>" first, then "<source>/<kind>" (a decor type "<kind>_<n>" without its _<n>), then by_source. range_m: every piece of the batch is drawn at least out to this camera distance; 0 = never culled. A batch whose pieces have colliders never ends below sight_floor_m (the code raises it; 0 stays never). margin_m is the end margin, hysteresis with fade disabled.
